title: Plugin models, the tables outside AppSync and the vector index carry the tenant
description:
Outcome: Reader-steering models (ReaderProfile, ReaderHandle, ReaderVote, ReaderFlag, ReaderComment, ReaderSubmission, ReaderReport, ModerationAction) and SignupEntry get tenant-prefixed ids and keys (a vote id becomes "<tenant>#<subjectKey>#<readerId>#<dimension>"). Tables outside AppSync: NewsletterTable (pk/sk, amplify/plugins/newsletter/papyrus.plugin.ts) gets "<tenant>#" in pk; ReferenceWordTable (partition "shard", amplify/functions/reference-word-index/wire.ts) gets the tenant in the shard; PublicFormsLimits, PapyrusReaderRateWindows and PapyrusSignupRateCounters get the tenant in their keys; the remote-login Transactions and ChallengeThrottle tables (amplify/cli-login/remote-login.ts) record the tenant the login is for. The S3 Vectors knowledge index (site-backend.ts, deriveKnowledgeVectorIndexName) either gets one index per tenant or a mandatory tenant metadata filter (decided in this task with a measured query). The projection lock table key moves to "<bucket>#<tenant>" in PPY-994bd0.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/plugins/reader-steering/schema.ts and function/, amplify/plugins/signup/, amplify/plugins/newsletter/papyrus.plugin.ts and ops, amplify/functions/reference-word-index/, amplify/functions/public-forms/wire.ts, amplify/cli-login/remote-login.ts, amplify/site-backend.ts (vector index), src/papyrus_knowledge_query.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-plugin-keys.feature):
Scenario: A title-word search returns only the tenant's References
    Given the word "ransomware" in titles of "alpha" and "beta"
    When "alpha" searches it
    Then only "alpha" References return

Scenario: A reader's vote on one site is not visible on another
    Given a reader votes on alpha's story
    When beta's snapshot runs
    Then beta's files contain no trace of the vote

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-cd5926, PPY-94d609. Blocks PPY-bdc4ee, PPY-8f9462, PPY-6b084f, PPY-5219fc, PPY-1f83a6. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-e277e3.

Testing: pytest and TS tests per table; the adversarial suite's search and reader cases.
Rollout: Per plugin; dual-read then backfill. The vector index decision may need a re-index of each tenant's vectors (a sweep, metered).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: the vector filter is skipped by a query path. Mitigation: one query function adds the filter; a test calls every path with a foreign tenant.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
